mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because it showed how an electrical change can pass along a fibre without one particle travelling the whole way.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the receiving branches was straightforward but gave me little choice beyond following the picture and goal.

surprise.text: I was surprised that neighbouring channels open in sequence rather than one charged particle travelling the length of the fibre.

arbitrary.text: None of the pairings felt arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained where the parts belonged. The ATP-using pump appeared already in place, though, so its detailed operation wasn't explained.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter to see how nerve cells connect to other body parts, although this chapter's choices were mostly obvious pairings.
